body.name: \(P_m^{\mathrm{Par}}\)
body.construction: For fixed even \(m\), draw \(X\) uniformly on \(\mathcal X_m\), draw \(A\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\) independently conditional on \(X\), draw \(L(0)\) and \(L(1)\) conditionally independently with \(P_m^{\mathrm{Par}}\{L(a)>y\mid X=x\}=y^{-2}\) for every \(x,a\) and \(y\ge1\), and set \(L=L(A)\). Thus \(c_{xa}=1\), \(\alpha_{xa}=2\), and \(r_{xa}=0\).
